sloka: तत्र अनेन अस्मि सम्रुद्धः राज्यम् मृगयत आत्मनः ।सुग्रीवेण नृशंसेन विस्मृत्य भ्रातृ सौहृदम् ॥४-१०-२५॥
transliteration: tatra anena asmi samruddhaḥ rājyam mṛgayata ātmanaḥ ।sugrīveṇa nṛśaṁsena vismṛtya bhrātṛ sauhṛdam ॥4-10-25॥

translations.english: 'I was obstructed by wicked Sugriva who forgot his brotherly love and was desiring the kingdom, which belongs to me.'
